title: run_cloud_test's fake hold feed line does not reproduce the real run_held reason prefix
description:
TestRunCloudEndsHoldingForTriageAndTriageSettlesIt hand-crafts its run_held detail as prose ('the close-out does not hand over...') instead of the real reason-first shape the reconciler writes ('finding_untriaged: <message>'), so the watch's triage-verb branch is never exercised end-to-end on the cloud path — the test passes through the settle branch with prose that merely mentions triage. The local path covers the branch (TestWatchHoldAlertNamesTriageForAFindingHold); the fake should reproduce the real shape.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 4fc335eb9911206ac998edbdf1d467eeeee619327383ad1423185e3ccdda90b8 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-gtk/attempt-40): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A2. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/4fc335eb9911206ac998edbdf1d467eeeee619327383ad1423185e3ccdda90b8.json on the run branch.
notes:
2026-09-27 18:46 - ticfac run epic-2jn: created by absorbing finding 4fc335eb9911206ac998edbdf1d467eeeee619327383ad1423185e3ccdda90b8 — placed before the close-out, which does not start while it is open; the review had already run. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/4fc335eb9911206ac998edbdf1d467eeeee619327383ad1423185e3ccdda90b8.json on epic/2jn, and it says: no classifier prediction could be made — no classifier is configured for gating predictions — so the reporter's own claim decides: it breaks A2, and the finding is absorbed against that item.
